name: Hermes Pets
author: Madmasx
description: Animated Hermes petdex companion in the Omarchy bar: it plays sprite sheets from ~/.hermes/pets, looks at your cursor, waves when clicked, and can be pinned to the desktop. Reacts to Hermes agent activity when the activity hook is wired in.

schema.label: Pet
schema.description: Directory name under the pets folder. Pick it from the panel.

schema.label: Pinned
schema.description: Keep the pet on the desktop with the panel closed.

schema.label: Pinned X
schema.description: Left edge of the pinned pet in screen pixels. -1 keeps it below its bar icon; dragging the pet sets it.

schema.label: Pinned Y
schema.description: Top edge of the pinned pet in screen pixels. -1 keeps it below its bar icon; dragging the pet sets it.

schema.label: Random behaviour
schema.description: Roam: pause 8-20s, then walk to a random spot along the floor.

schema.label: Animate
schema.description: Off shows a single still frame and runs no timer.

schema.label: React to Hermes activity
schema.description: When on, the pet changes pose based on Hermes agent state.

schema.label: Movable pet
schema.description: Allow dragging the pet when pinned to desktop.

schema.label: Open Desktop on click
schema.description: When on, clicking the pet opens Hermes Desktop.

schema.label: Pet scale
schema.description: Scale factor for the pet sprite (0.25 to 3.0, default 1.0).
